details:
AstroGenesis AI Studio

AstroGenesis AI Studio is an AI-powered astronomy and space exploration platform that combines artificial intelligence, real astronomical data, interactive 3D simulations, and scientific education to create an immersive experience for everyone, from young learners to researchers and aspiring astronauts.

The platform features a realistic, interactive 3D solar system containing the Sun, Moon, all eight planets, and Pluto, with celestial information and planetary positions based on trusted NASA data. Users can explore planets, discover their physical characteristics, atmospheres, weather conditions, environments, and scientific mysteries through interactive explanations.

One of its key features is a planetary mission analysis system that helps users investigate potential landing opportunities by studying planetary conditions, mission parameters, and relevant astronomical information.

AstroGenesis also introduces an AI-powered learning environment for children, where they can draw planets, receive intelligent feedback, and improve their understanding of astronomy through creativity. For students, teachers, scientists, and space enthusiasts, the platform offers advanced scientific tools, astronomical equations, and automated calculations.

Our vision is to transform the way people learn about and interact with the universe by bringing scientific knowledge, artificial intelligence, and space exploration together in one accessible digital environment.
